title: Studio: object pickers offer only objects inside the package's dependency closure; the dependencies editor is reachable from Studio
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect · reach: Studio UI, measured once (below). ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #28236 (P0, child **N-07**) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: S.

**Business reason.** Every customization package needs the base's objects; the platform admits only objects inside the package's dependency closure. Studio offers objects outside it, lets the author build on them, and only then shows a refusal — the author finds out after the work is done.

**Measured** at `d6c0a75f1a` (showcase): a new writable package (no dependencies) → Automations → New → "When a record is created" → the object picker lists showcase objects (`showcase_expense_report`, `showcase_task`, …); choosing `showcase_task` saves a draft, then the canvas shows "triggers on object 'showcase_task', which is outside the closure of package 'com.default.acme-custom' … so the package may not bind a flow to it"; a view on the same object is refused at publish (`list-view-object-outside-closure`). The closure is the server's (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts` `resolveWritePackageScope`).

**Wanted.**
1. Object pickers in Studio (flow trigger, new view/report/dashboard data source, lookup target) list only objects inside the open package's closure: its own, its declared dependencies', platform objects. Objects outside are absent, or listed disabled with the reason and a link to declare the dependency.
2. Confirm the package form's dependencies editor (`metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx` + `package-schema.ts` `dependencies`) is reachable from Studio's New package and package settings; if not, wire it. (Not found in the browser walkthrough; the code has it.)
3. Tests: picker filtered by closure; after adding the dependency the object appears; the server refusal no longer reachable through the picker.

**Not here.** The `<base>.custom` package (declares its dependency automatically, N-13).

**Dedupe.** `"outside the closure" picker` open+closed: 15 hits; #24669 (closed) is the lint-side refusal, related. `object picker closure flow trigger`: 49 hits, none for the Studio picker.

Links back: #28236, ADR-0141.
